{{Top}}
'''Ditanium''' was a natural element used in the construction of plating that covered military structures. It was found in a vein on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] by the [[Mairan/Legends|Mairan]]. Ditanium plating was used to reinforce the outer walls of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="GG5-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
